verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's own IAM documents fine-grained control of who can do what on which resource. Workload Identity Federation gives workloads access through federated identities instead of service account keys, which is a native basis for least-privilege credentials. The evidence does not show agent-specific credential issuance, scoped tokens, or service-account role binding for an agent. Missing for 10: explicit docs on issuing scoped or short-lived credentials for agents, service account and role-scoping details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: IAM memungkinkan Anda mengontrol _siapa_ yang dapat melakukan _apa_ pada _resource mana_.
IAM est un outil permettant de gérer les autorisations précises pour Google Cloud.
you can provide on-premises or multicloud workloads with access to Google Cloud resources by using federated identities instead of a service account key
